name: text_summarizer
description: Text processing tool for summarization, keyword extraction, word/character counting, and sentiment analysis. Use when user asks to: 'summarize this text', 'extract keywords from', 'count words in', 'analyze sentiment of', 'is this positive or negative', 'get key terms from', or 'how many words/characters in'. Also use this after reading a long stash/text artifact when the next step is summarization or analysis: pass stash_ref (or space_id+file_id) instead of calling stash.read again.

text.description: The text to process. Optional if stash_ref or space_id+file_id is provided.

stash_ref.description: stash:// reference to a text file to process directly. Use this for long stash artifacts instead of re-reading the same file.

space_id.description: Stash space ID for a text file to process directly. Use with file_id when stash_ref is unavailable.

file_id.description: Stash file ID or name for a text file to process directly. Use with space_id when stash_ref is unavailable.

operation.description: Operation to perform: 'summarize' for text summary, 'keywords' for keyword extraction, 'count' for word/character count, 'sentiment' for sentiment analysis

action.description: Alias for operation, supported for older workflows

num_sentences.description: Number of sentences in extractive summary, or rough detail hint when method is auto/llm

method.description: Summarization method. auto uses configured LLM for long text and extractive summarization for short text.

use_llm.description: Force configured LLM summarization for summarize operation. Overrides method when true.

focus.description: Optional focus instruction for summaries, such as pricing, implementation details, risks, or decisions

llm_min_chars.description: Minimum input characters before auto mode uses the configured LLM

llm_provider.description: Optional provider override for LLM summarization: openai, anthropic, xai, or ollama

llm_model.description: Optional model override for LLM summarization

top_n.description: Number of top keywords to extract (only for keywords operation)

num_keywords.description: Alias for top_n, supported for older workflows

test_input.text: Artificial intelligence is transforming the world. Machine learning algorithms are becoming more sophisticated. Natural language processing enables computers to understand human language. This technology has many applications in business and research.
